This is illegal production and sale of counterfeit or illegal drugs? Chinese criminal law: "生产、销售假药" (manufacture and sale of counterfeit or fake drugs). Also "非法生产、销售药品" maybe "非法生产、销售药品罪". The facts: He didn't produce himself but ordered from a company lacking licenses, then sold. He helped a foreign person find manufacturer. He imported and sold counterfeit weight loss drugs. The value is 13.84万元 (138,400 RMB) for one batch, total maybe >20万元 but <50万元. So crime: "非法生产、销售假药" or "生产、销售假药罪". The key rule: must use exact legal term as appears in facts. The fact mentions "三无产品" (no production date, no quality certificate, no manufacturer). That's typical for "假药". The crime likely "生产、销售假药罪". Also maybe "非法经营罪"? But the description: "以不合格产品冒充合格产品，销售金额二十万元以上不满五十万元" matches the provision for "非法生产、销售假药罪" (Article 141 of Criminal Law). So output single crime.
